title: OpenFeature eval context namespace must not be wildcard/empty
answers: Why is flag evaluation being rejected with a namespace mismatch?
Feature flag / OpenFeature eval context has wrong namespace for wildcard identity
How is the OpenFeature evaluation context namespace determined?
body: The OpenFeature evaluation context's namespace/targeting key must always be a concrete namespace, never "*" or empty. It is computed in pkg/services/contexthandler/contexthandler.go:setRequestContext with fallback order: id.Namespace (only if non-empty and not "*") -> "stacks-"+cfg.StackID (if StackID set) -> "default". If this falls through to a wildcard/empty value, downstream flag evaluation requests get rejected as a namespace mismatch since the caller's concrete auth namespace no longer matches.
applies: Any code path setting or consuming the OpenFeature evaluation context namespace/targeting key in Grafana core.
